title: AI-PVR Insight deep learning diagnoses proliferative vitreoretinopathy from imaging
summary: TwinsSVT and DenseNet-121 extracted features from B-scan ultrasound, OCT and ultra-widefield images of 1,700 eyes, with MLP or SVM classifiers on fused features. PVR identification reached AUC 0.976 internally and 0.971 on a 213-eye external test set, and postoperative risk prediction AUC was above 0.827. The study is retrospective across two hospitals with no prospective or reader-impact evidence.
ai_technology: TwinsSVT and DenseNet-121 feature extractors with PCA, feature fusion and MLP or SVM classifiers
organization: Nanchang University; Jiangxi Provincial People's Hospital

evidence.tested: Internal and independent external test sets from a second hospital.
evidence.unknown: Prospective performance and effect on clinicians.
evidence.ai_role: Identifies, grades and predicts postoperative PVR risk
